title: FutureSearch: Search the Future
excerpt: AI forecasting with a public track record. First in Metaculus's Summer 2026 FutureEval tournament, above the superforecaster median on ForecastBench, and every forecast draws on a shared world model that compounds with use. Research trusted by Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, and xAI.
content_html:
Forecast anything:

$0.15 to $2 per question, low to high effort.

Plus the toolkit around a forecast: multi-agents and research teams.

Our public track record
